messages.text: Have a defective 310 need a replacement

Hi, I'm H., HeliumDeploy's technical specialist. Sarah passed this over to me.

Before anything gets decided on a replacement, I need to confirm the fault with you.

Two quick things:

1. Is the 310 the Wingbits MGW310, or a different unit?
2. What exactly is it doing? For example: no power at all, no LEDs, powers on but never connects, or an error on screen / in the dashboard.

Start with those and we'll work through it one step at a time.
I talked to wingbit and they ask me to send for a replacement as the device is faulty

Thanks, that helps. I just need two things from you so I can put a proper record together:

1. What is the actual symptom you and Wingbits saw? For example no power / no LEDs, it powers up but never comes online, no GPS fix, or no ADS-B data in the dashboard.
2. A clear photo of the label with the serial number, plus a short video of the unit when you power it up.

Send those over and I'll take it from there.
Dont have a video but have a ticket number wingbit diganose device as faulty and its on roof dont want to go on roof just to take a picture

Fair enough, no need to climb the roof.

Two things that work just as well:

1. The W. ticket number, so the fault is on record from their side.
2. In one line, what Wingbits said was wrong with it (for example no GPS fix, unit offline, no ADS-B data reaching the server).

Those two are enough for me to write it up.
It known hardware defects and its adb is faulty
Verdict recorded and the chat is back with Sarah.
